main.description: The repositories the asking account watches or ignores, and the pulls and issues it subscribed to or muted, the latest choice first, as the appview keeps them. What it never chose for is heard of as its part in it says, and is not listed. A repository it can no longer find is left out. Requires authentication: a service token, or the session cookie the pages' login sets.

level.description: As dev.knotless.putSubscription takes it; `participating` when there is no choice.

subject.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, by the name it has now, or the pull or issue.

createdAt.description: When it chose, from which it counts. Absent when there is no choice.

subscription.description: What an account chose to hear of one repository, pull or issue.

description: What the asking account chose to hear of repositories, pulls and issues.
